# STFM: Society of Teachers of Family Medicine

> STFM is the professional home for academic family medicine educators, offering membership, professional development, advocacy resources, and community engagement through conferences and online platforms.

The Society of Teachers of Family Medicine (STFM) serves as the leading organization for family medicine educators and academic professionals in the United States. STFM provides comprehensive resources including membership programs, continuing education, advocacy initiatives, and networking opportunities through STFM Connect and annual conferences.

## Key Topics

- Family Medicine Education
- Academic Family Medicine
- STFM Membership
- STFM Connect
- Medical Education
- Faculty Development
- Advocacy & Policy
- Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
- STFM Foundation
- Professional Leadership
- Health Equity
- ACGME & Competency-Based Medical Education
- Annual Spring Conference
- Member Engagement
- Rural Healthcare

## Membership & Community

- [Join STFM or Renew Membership](https://stfm.org/about/membership/join-renew): Join or renew STFM membership with flexible categories and payment options
- [STFM Connect Community Portal](https://connect.stfm.org/home): STFM Connect community portal for members to access resources and network
- [STFM: Home for Academic Family Medicine Professionals](https://stfm.org): STFM homepage with resources, courses, and conference information

## About STFM & Organization

- [About STFM and Family Medicine Education](https://stfm.org/about/about/about-stfm-and-family-medicine-education): Overview of STFM history, founding, and strategic plan priorities
- [2025–2029 Strategic Plan](https://stfm.org/about/governance/strategic-plan): STFM's five-year strategic plan covering education, leadership, and health equity
- [STFM Foundation](https://stfm.org/foundation/home): STFM Foundation advancing family medicine through scholarships and fellowships
- [Contact STFM Staff](https://stfm.org/about/about/contact-us): STFM staff directory and contact information for all departments

## Governance & Leadership

- [Leadership Opportunities With STFM](https://stfm.org/about/governance/leadership-opportunities): Board positions, committee roles, and volunteer opportunities at STFM
- [List of STFM Committees](https://stfm.org/about/governance/committees/committees): Directory of STFM committees and organizational structure
- [Statements From STFM](https://stfm.org/about/governance/stfm-statements): Official STFM statements on ethics, diversity, and organizational policy

## Advocacy & Policy

- [Advocacy: A Professional Responsibility for Family Medicine Educators](https://stfm.org/about/advocacy/advocacy-in-family-medicine): Resources for family medicine advocacy at multiple professional levels
- [CAFM Advocacy Action Center](https://stfm.org/about/advocacy/advocacy-action-center): CAFM advocacy action center for congressional engagement on family medicine
- [Family Medicine Advocacy Resources and Key Issues](https://stfm.org/about/advocacy/resources-issues): Advocacy resources on Medicare GME, rural healthcare, and physician workforce
- [Family Medicine DEI Advocacy Toolkit](https://stfm.org/about/advocacy/family-medicine-dei-advocacy-toolkit): Toolkit for advocating diversity, equity, and inclusion in family medicine
- [STFM Advocacy Decision-Making](https://stfm.org/about/advocacy/advocacy-decision-making): Framework for STFM advocacy decision-making and policy engagement
